During the later period of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew an '''[[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor]]'''. Kenobi [[pilot]]ed the [[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|interceptor]] during a mission to rescue [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant|Battle of]] [[Coruscant]]. The [[starfighter]] was destroyed aboard the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[flagship]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]''.<ref name="RotS" />

==History==
===Destruction of the Separatist supply storage base===
When the [[Jedi Order]] received a tip about the location of a [[Separatist supply storage base]] in the interior of an [[asteroid]], Kenobi and Master [[Quinlan Vos]] requested for Skywalker and another [[Jedi Knight]] named [[Akar-Deshu]] to accompany them in seizing the base and its supplies. The four Jedi flew to the base in their Eta-2's and engaged six [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] defending it. Kenobi, Skywalker and Vos landed their starfighters at the base, while Desh returned to their [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]] to bring reinforcements.<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref>

===Destruction of the Vanqor listening station===
After their failure to extract the supplies at the storage base, the [[Jedi High Council]] sent Vos, accompanied by Kenobi and Skywalker, to lead an operation to destroy a [[Vanqor listening station|Separatist listening post]] on the [[planet]] [[Vanqor]]. The three flew in their Eta-2s, alongside twenty-four [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170]] starfighters. Upon arriving at the facility, they discovered it to be abandoned, as [[Dooku|Count Dooku]] had evacuated all personnel before they had arrived. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, Vos had leaked information about the operation to Dooku, as part of his plan to work as a double agent in order to reach [[Darth Sidious]] and destroy the [[Sith]] once and for all.<ref name="Dark Disciple" />

===Battle of Coruscant===

[[File:E3cspa32.jpg|left|thumb|Kenobi's Eta-2 severely damaged by buzz droids in the Battle of Coruscant.|250x250px]]
After [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] had been kidnapped during the [[Battle of Coruscant]], Kenobi flew in his Eta-2 to rescue him, alongside Skywalker who flew in [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|his own Eta-2]]. During the battle, a vulture droid fired four [[discord missile]]s at Kenobi and Skywalker. While Skywalker was able to destroy the missiles tailing him, the missiles tailing Kenobi released a swarm of [[Pistoeka sabotage droid]]s that latched onto his ship. They quickly began shutting down the ship's systems and ripped his [[astromech droid]] [[R4-P17]]'s dome off, effectively destroying her. Skywalker attempted to shoot the droids off Kenobi's starfighter, but ended up blowing off his port-side [[S-foils|s-foil]], much to Kenobi's displeasure. Skywalker then tried ramming into him to destroy the remaining droids and succeeded, save for one which crawled onto his own starfighter. [[R2-D2]] would electrocute the last droid. The pair then crash-landed in the ''[[Invisible Hand]]''<nowiki/>'s [[hangar]] bay. The starfighter was destroyed when the ''Invisible Hand''<nowiki/>'s aft section, containing the hangar, broke off from the front upon entry into [[Coruscant]]'s atmosphere due to the damage it had sustained in the battle.<ref name="RotS" />

Kenobi would replace his fallen starfighter with a new [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor|blue Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptor]], and would receive a new [[astromech droid]], [[R4-G9]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Crew==
The starfighter was piloted by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who also functioned as its captain. Kenobi's [[astromech droid]] [[R4-P17]] functioned as the ship's navigator and repairer should it get damaged in combat.<ref name="RotS" />
